reason.transitions: Scene transitions cannot be exported right now. Remove the transitions to export this video.
reason.transition_camera: A scene transition cannot be drawn with a Motion scene that moves the camera. Set a cut at this scene boundary.
reason.transition_content: A scene transition cannot be drawn with a Motion scene that uses video or component content. Set a cut at this scene boundary.
reason.transition_anchor: A scene transition cannot be drawn with a Motion scene whose timing follows words or beats. Set a cut at this scene boundary.
reason.transition_invalid: A scene transition of this video is not valid. Set it again or set a cut.
reason.transition_video: Scene transitions cannot be exported together with video clips yet. Set cuts at the scene boundaries to export this video.

transition.firstScene: The first scene has no scene before it, so it has no transition.
transition.shortened: Shortened to {seconds} s: the scenes next to it are not long enough for more.
transition.tooShort: A scene next to this boundary is too short for a transition, so it plays as a cut.
transition.unresolved: A scene next to this boundary has no length yet, so it plays as a cut.
transition.videoCut: A scene next to this boundary holds video, so it plays as a cut, in the editor preview and in the exported video.
transition.cannotPreview: This transition cannot be previewed (a scene next to it cannot take part), so the preview shows a cut.
transition.off: Scene transitions are not available right now.
transition.needsPreview: Turn on the editor preview to set scene transitions.

chip.set: Transition into scene {n}: {name}, {seconds} s. Press Enter to edit it.
chip.cut: No transition into scene {n} (a cut). Press Enter to add one.

transition.previewOnlyCut: Preview only: the editor plays this transition, the exported video plays a cut here (footage cannot be blended in the export yet).
transition.previewOnlyRefused: Preview only: the editor plays this transition, but a video that holds footage cannot be exported with scene transitions yet.

previewOnlyBadge.cut: Preview only · exports as a cut
previewOnlyBadge.refused: Preview only · cannot be exported yet
